name.en: Concert stage (LED wall, cubes, trays, deck)

source.symbol: bigBeastMaterials; loadStage (led_cube, led_wall); ledShow mode 0, ledGrid, hsv
source.note: The Big Beast stage's eleven looks as one material, chosen per vertex by the part index tools/glb-join.mjs writes into the vertex colour alpha, so the stage is one draw. The music uniforms of the music-video app are replaced by the builder's: a slow pulse from the TSL clock, the screens' level from `show`, the LED wall showing led.js's slow colour field (mode 0) on its pixel grid (no IMAG feed, no rendered galaxy). Above show 1 the lights are turned up: a warm wash on the deck and skirt and warm-lit panes among the cubes (our addition; at 1 the look is the source's). The skirt's sheen and the cubes' clearcoat are left out on Phone.
